description: This Java class `TcpIoStream` implements the `IoStream` interface to handle TCP socket communication, providing methods for reading, writing, closing the stream, and setting a data listener.

classes.name: TcpIoStream
classes.description: Implements TCP-based input/output stream handling conforming to the IoStream interface, managing socket communication with threading for asynchronous data reading.

methods.name: TcpIoStream
methods.description: Constructor that initializes input and output streams; throws NullPointerException if inputs are null.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes bytes to the output stream and flushes.

methods.name: setInputListener
methods.description: Sets up a background thread to read incoming data asynchronously and notify the DataListener.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Returns whether the stream is marked as closed.
